title: SS28 Kids' Design and Production Innovations
summary: Design and production for SS28 kidswear: grade for growth, safety testing, product data for the EU passport.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 kidswear fairs (Pitti Bimbo and Playtime) take place in June 2027. This report projects from SS28 adult previews, the SS27 kidswear fair record and long-term drivers such as heat and UV protection, and will be updated after the fairs.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Future Snoops' SS28 performance preview: "smart translucent membranes, hyperlight wovens, and innovative technical silks", ultrastretch wovens, modular constructions and articulated seams<sup>[1]</sup>
- The EU textiles Digital Product Passport delegated act is planned for the fourth quarter of 2027, so SS28 production is the first to be planned under it<sup>[2]</sup>
- Première Vision Paris presents SS28 collections on 26-28 January 2027<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Actions
sections.body:
- Grade for growth.
- Safety test results recorded per style.
- Fibre and origin data.

design_implications:
- Record fibre, origin, care and test results for every style.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Plan production around Lunar New Year and EU product-data rules.
